annotations.title: Fill in a saved reply for a draft

description: Fill in a saved reply's merge fields for one draft's recipient, from their contact's fields (found by the draft's address). Someone who isn't a contact fills only {{ email }}. A field the recipient has no value for stays in the text as written and is listed in `unfilled`: the draft can't be sent until you replace it with real words. Spintax picks one choice at random. Nothing is written or sent. `body` is the saved reply's plain text: put it into the draft's `bodyText` where you want it (in place of the message, or before or after what is there) with update_draft and `revision: draftRevision`. On a new message, `subject` is the saved reply's subject; a reply keeps its own and gets null. A draft with a formatted (HTML) part answers 409: most mail apps show that part, so clear it first with `bodyHtml: ""`. A sent draft answers 409.

draftId.description: The draft it goes in. Its recipient's contact fields fill the merge fields.
